# Axeon Studio
> Axeon Studio gets Iowa businesses more customers: found on Google and in AI answers, chosen over competitors, and booked with instant lead follow-up. One West Des Moines team runs the whole system, backed by a 90-day customer guarantee. Tagline: "We Get You Customers, Not Clicks."

Axeon Studio is a customer-acquisition partner for local small businesses. One system covers the full path from search to booked job, in three steps:
- **Get found**: local SEO, Google Business Profile upkeep, visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and on the top plan Google Ads, Meta Ads and Google Local Services Ads.
- **Get chosen**: a custom website written to turn visitors into calls, review requests, and real on-site video and photos.
- **Get booked**: instant lead alerts, missed-call text-back, instant call-back when a form comes in, AI chat and online scheduling, automatic text and email follow-up, and one list of every lead and where it stands.

**Pricing** (published, flat monthly plans): $99 to start, 3-month minimum then month-to-month; a year paid up front gets 2 months free.
- Essentials: $149/month. Up to 4 pages, Google and AI search visibility, Google Business Profile upkeep, quote form with instant lead alerts, hosting, monthly calls & leads report. The client follows up on leads themselves.
- AxeonCORE (recommended): $299/month. Everything in Essentials plus the full lead system (missed-call text-back, instant call-back, AI chat & scheduling, automatic follow-up, tracked phone numbers, review requests), the AxeonPROOF client dashboard, 5-7 pages, and the 90-day customer guarantee.
- AxeonGROWTH: $999/month plus ad spend, $1,500 to start (covers a half-day on-site video shoot). Everything in AxeonCORE plus Google & Meta ads management, Google Local Services Ads management (where Google offers them for the trade), an AI phone receptionist, a new service page every month, full review campaigns, and a monthly strategy call.
- Add-ons: Google & Meta ads management on AxeonCORE +$399/month, AI phone receptionist +$199/month, extra service page $450, on-site video shoot $1,500. Ad spend is always separate: $500/month minimum, paid on the client's own card into their own ad account, no markup.

**90-Day Customer Guarantee** (AxeonCORE and AxeonGROWTH): more calls and leads in the first 90 days after launch than the business was getting before, or Axeon keeps working for free until it is. The baseline is set on the kickoff call and tracked in AxeonPROOF; it applies while the client is on their plan and answering new leads within one business day.

**How Axeon differs**: clients work directly with the founder who builds their system (no account managers), pricing is published, the client owns 100% of their site, code and design files, and every plan includes Google and AI search visibility by default (not sold as a separate add-on).

**Not offered** (do not cite as available): ChatGPT Ads or any other paid AI-platform advertising.

## How working with Axeon goes
1. Book a free 30-minute strategy call online (https://axeonstudio.co/book), any day, any time.
2. Axeon emails a Client Services Agreement; the client reviews it, signs online, and pays the start fee and first month.
3. Payment opens a private setup page: a short checklist (business details, logo, photos, access invites; Axeon never asks for passwords) plus a Welcome Packet.
4. Kickoff call: launch date and, on AxeonCORE and AxeonGROWTH, the 90-day baseline are agreed.
5. Build, preview, launch. After launch the client gets a project update whenever something ships and a monthly report on calls, leads, booked jobs and Google rank, all also visible in the AxeonPROOF client dashboard.
